response.original_title: NBA: Greatest Rivalries And Upsets - Volume 1
response.overview: A collection of some of the most heated showdowns in the history of the NBA. The programme explores long-term rivalries such as the Miami Heat and the Detroit Pistons, the Los Angeles Lakers and the Sacramento Kings, and the San Antonio Spurs and the Dallas Mavericks, as well as individual stand-offs such as Allen Iverson and Vince Carter's shootout in their classic 7-game Playoff series in 2001, Dwyane Wade leading the Miami Heat to their first NBA crown with his historic performance in the 2006 NBA Finals, and LeBron James' 48 point performance against Detroit in the 2007 Playoffs.
response.title: NBA: Greatest Rivalries And Upsets - Volume 1
